\[
\Delta E_{\text{cryst}} = -\frac{N \cdot e^2 \cdot M}{4 \pi \varepsilon_0 r_0} \cdot \left(1 - \frac{1}{n}\right)
\]

- \( N = 6.022 \times 10^{23} \, \text{mol}^{-1} \) (Avogadro's number),

- \( n = 8.7 \) (Born exponent),
